question: For each consultant, how many active candidates have not been contacted for more than two weeks?
sql: SELECT co.name AS consultant, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS candidates_not_contacted FROM consultants co LEFT JOIN candidates c ON c.consultant_id = co.id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM applications a WHERE a.candidate_id = c.id AND a.status = 'active') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activities ac WHERE ac.candidate_id = c.id AND ac.with_party = 'candidate' AND ac.at >= date('2026-11-25', '-14 day')) GROUP BY co.id, co.name ORDER BY candidates_not_contacted DESC, co.name LIMIT 200
answer: Hannah Pryce has the most active candidates not contacted for more than two weeks, with 4, while Priya Raman and Tom Okafor each have 3. That makes 10 candidates in total across the three consultants.

meta.note: Active candidate = has at least one active application; not contacted = no with_party='candidate' activity on or after 2026-11-11; consultants with zero are included.
